title: Kathleen A NDE 6581
content: I was with my family and a group of church people. We were gathered to have a day of pleasure. Picnicking, playing, swimming, and fellowshipping. I walked out along a pier that led to the deep part of the water. Although there were other kids there, I was ‘alone’ as I felt almost all of the time. I was feeling happy and brave and I jumped into the water (even though I couldn't swim and knew that). I was confident I could reach out and grab the edge of the concrete pier. When I reached the top of the water, I discovered I couldn't reach the edge! I desperately kicked my feet, trying to get them sideways so I could kick myself to the ledge, but I couldn't get my legs sideways. I remember going down under the water feet-first. I was experiencing total panic. I was drinking water in my mouth and I was under the water. I was physically fighting to get to the top and my entire self was wrapped in pure panic! I don't know how long I was in this state. It seemed forever and it seemed a second. The next conscious awareness I have, is that I'm under the water. I am experiencing the ‘peace that passeth all understanding’. I am aware that I am in my body and yet I am seeing myself ‘out there’ about five feet away. It has no form and yet I know it is me. There were words that came to me from the formless me. I can’t recall if the words were, ’I am never going to die,’ or, ‘you are never going to die.’ It's almost as if they are both. As if I'm there where the words are coming from. I’m in my body witnessing them, yet seeing they are me too! I remember the actual experiencing of forever never dying. My attention was then brought to my left side. I looked, and it felt like I was looking from inside my body. There I experienced pure black velvet, the texture of pure. Peace that had the feeling of pure black velvet. The shape of the black velvet tended to be somewhat like a tunnel, but not so clearly defined as a tunnel. I then continued to ‘soak in’ all the textures, and peace, and calm and contentment. I was soaking it all in. It was still like there was no time. And then I felt something grab my hair on the top of my head and I was pulled from the space I had been in. I have no recollection of who had me, what they did to me, or where I was. I only remember hearing voices saying things like, ‘oh, your Aunt will be so mad at you.’ My thoughts were saying inside myself, ‘I wish they would leave me alone and let me be with what I'm feeling!’ Note to reader, at this period of my life, I had pulled so deep into myself that I don't recall too much of anything other than I went along with being a ‘person,’ but most consciousness was hidden deep inside my Self. That was the only place I felt safe, so I don't have any recollection of what happened after.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Initially 'total panic' while drowning, then 'peace that passeth all understanding' while aware of self both in-body and as a 'formless me' about five feet away.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as 'pure black velvet' with a shape 'somewhat like a tunnel, but not so clearly defined as a tunnel.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Underwater experience of 'pure black velvet' darkness/void with strong texture-like quality and profound peace; 'somewhat like a tunnel' but not clearly defined.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt 'something grab my hair on the top of my head' and was 'pulled from the space' she had been in.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning after jumping off a pier despite not being able to swim.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: OBE-like dual awareness ('in my body' yet seeing 'formless me' five feet away) followed by black-velvet void/tunnel-like form, then forced return/pulling by hair.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience begins with drowning panic underwater, then peace and OBE-like perception while still underwater, then void/tunnel-like blackness, then abrupt pulling/return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneous awareness of being 'in my body' while also perceiving a 'formless me' about five feet away, experienced as also being 'me'.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Underwater NDE with 'pure black velvet' texture-like darkness and an OBE described as a 'formless me' five feet away; return initiated by hair being grabbed and pulled.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “peace that passeth all understanding”; “pure black velvet”; “I am never going to die” / “you are never going to die.”
